metadata.title: Emmy Noether: Modern LaTeX Working Corpus and Multilingual Translation Readers
metadata.version: 2026-07-18 multilingual R823 corpus with Interslavic normalization through Tranche 007

metadata.description:
This is the reader-facing Emmy Noether working record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. It contains the current German R823 LaTeX source-control reader, the cumulative English working corpus, 473-page Spanish and 494-page French R823 working translations, Interslavic Latin and Cyrillic working readers and editable units, bounded Simplified/Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Slavic, Arabic, Persian, and Indonesian components, and source-repair/audit material.

Current Interslavic corpus: file 11 now incorporates normalization Tranches 002A through 007. It contains 221 Latin-script and 221 Cyrillic-script editable units, all 442 unit PDFs, cumulative readers of 527 and 551 pages, exact manifests, and bounded change evidence. Tranches 003-007 record 1,111 reviewed replacements across 247 distinct units. The final streaming audit covers 221/221 canonical Latin units and closes the internally resolvable declared queue.

Known Interslavic boundary: 353 važi*|važe* mathematical sense-extension probes in 101 files remain explicitly blocked on external linguistic or community authority. Retained ręd*, jednako*, slučaj*, and kolc* families are reviewed retention decisions rather than unfinished automatic-replacement queues.

Other principal contents: the record retains the German R823 source control and bounded Paper 30 hard-mathematics audit, the English corpus, the Spanish and French cumulative readers with editable-source/evidence packages, and the bounded multilingual components listed above.

Status caveat: these are substantial working editions, translations, and source-control artifacts. They are not official critical editions, peer review, mathematical proof certification, native-language or community certification, or guarantees that every symbol and translation choice is correct. Build/render checks establish artifact integrity; bounded source audits establish only their stated scopes. OCR/VLM output is locator or comparison evidence unless direct source reconciliation is explicitly recorded.

GitHub: corrections and improvements can be proposed through issues or pull requests at https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.

Interslavic normalization is current through Tranche 007 with a final 221-unit audit; 353 važi*/važe* probes remain an explicit external-authority blocker. Not a critical edition, native-language certificate, peer review, proof check, or whole-corpus accuracy guarantee.
